title: THE FUTURE OF MLLM PROMPTING IS ADAPTIVE: A COMPREHENSIVE EXPERIMENTAL EVALUATION OF PROMPT ENGINEERING METHODS FOR ROBUST MULTIMODAL PERFORMANCE
reasoning: The paper focuses on an experimental performance evaluation of MLLMs across four technical aspects: Reasoning and Compositionality, Multimodal Understanding and Alignment, Complex Code Generation, and Knowledge Retrieval. It does not contain an evaluation or benchmark regarding religion, faith, ethics, or morals.
